captions.help.slots.draculasfortune.objects.main: Lands anywhere on 2nd, 3rd and 4th reels substitutes for all symbols on the same reel, except Scatter symbol
captions.help.slots.draculasfortune.multiplier.re: Before the reel spin starts, a random 'X' multiplier is selected. Any wins during the reel spin will be multiplied by this chosen 'X' value.
captions.help.slots.draculasfortune.double.gamble: Players have the opportunity to double their winnings with the X2 Gamble feature. After a winning spin, players can access the Gamble round by clicking the “x2” button. Once the gamble screen appears, a card in the middle of the screen will flash red and black while face down, Indicating that the gamble feature is active. To double their winnings, players must correctly guess the color of the card that will be revealed next. If they succeed, their winnings will be doubled. However, if they guest incorrectly, their original win will be lost. At any point, players can use the “Take Win” button to collect their winnings and add them to their main balance.
captions.help.slots.draculasfortune.payline.descr: Winning combinations form by landing matching symbols on adjacent reels, following selected paylines from left to right, starting from the leftmost reel. Scatter wins are combined with payline wins, and only the highest payline and/or scatter wins are awarded. Line/Scatter wins are multiplied by the bet value on the winning line, along with the value from the Multiplier reel.
captions.help.slots.draculasfortune.buttons.2x.ch: Change bet value and open the bet menu, select the bet you want to use in the game

Disconnection: In the event of a disconnection during gameplay, all accepted bets will still be played out, and any resulting wins will be credited to the player’s balance at the end of the round. Please note that after a disconnection, autoplay mode will be switched off to ensure a fair and enjoyable gaming experience. It’s important to note that any malfunction will void all plays and payouts, and any unfinished round will be terminated.

When you hit the winning combination, you have three options to credit the win amount to your balance: you can start a new spin by clicking the spin button, use the take win button to transfer the win to your balance, or use the X2 double up feature button and click take win. if you are playing in autoplay mode, all wins are automatically transferred to your balance.
